answer:
In 2016, the host of the longest running American game show was **Drew Carey**.

The longest-running American game show is **"The Price is Right,"** which premiered on September 4, 1972. While Bob Barker served as the original host for 35 years (1972–2007), Drew Carey assumed the hosting role in April 2007 and continued to host through 2016.
